Car diagnostics and troubleshooting in Bukit Indah

We find the problem first, then explain it clearly before any repair.

WhatsApp usCall us

Warning light, strange noise or a car that just does not feel right? Our technicians troubleshoot the problem at our Taman Bukit Indah workshop.

We explain what we find in plain words and show you the defect, with video when it helps, so you can decide on the repair.

WhatsApp us your car model and year and describe what you notice. A short video of the noise or warning light helps.

Bring the car in for

  • Warning lights
  • Strange noises or vibration
  • Starting or running problems
  • A second look before a big repair

Recent work in our bay

How a tyre job goes

Four steps, one visit.

  1. WhatsApp us

    Send your car model and year, and your tyre size if you have it.

  2. We inspect and recommend

    We check your tyres and wheels, then tell you what you need and why.

  3. Fit, balance and align

    New tyres go on the Hunter changer, each wheel is balanced, then the alignment is set.

  4. Collect your car

    We show you what was done, you pay and drive off.

Questions drivers ask

Will you tell me what is wrong before fixing it?

Yes. We explain the defect clearly, with video when it helps, before any repair.
